build_gemini_realtime_config: build a Gemini realtime config object that transforms OpenAI realtime events to Gemini API format
transform_realtime_response: transform a Gemini realtime server response message into OpenAI realtime event format
transform_realtime_request: transform an OpenAI realtime client request into Gemini API realtime input format
map_openai_params: map OpenAI realtime API parameters to Gemini generation config format
transform_session_created_event: transform a Gemini setup complete event into an OpenAI session created event
